visualizations.title: Total Visitors
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT HOUR(etl_data_hourly.date) AS hour, SUM(etl_data_hourly.value) AS total FROM etl_data_hourly JOIN person_types ON etl_data_hourly.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE etl_data_hourly.stream_id IN (? /* $streamIds array */) AND person_types.name != '' AND etl_data_hourly.date BETWEEN ? /* $startOfToday */ AND ? /* $endOfToday */ GROUP BY HOUR(etl_data_hourly.date);

visualizations.title: Unique Visitors
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT DATE(etl_data_hourly.date) AS day, HOUR(etl_data_hourly.date) AS hour, SUM(etl_data_hourly.value) AS total FROM etl_data_hourly JOIN metrics ON etl_data_hourly.metric_id = metrics.id JOIN person_types ON etl_data_hourly.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE etl_data_hourly.stream_id IN (? /* $streamIds array */) AND metrics.name = 'Unique' AND person_types.name != 'Staff' AND etl_data_hourly.date BETWEEN ? /* $startOfToday */ AND ? /* $endOfToday */ GROUP BY DATE(etl_data_hourly.date), HOUR(etl_data_hourly.date);

visualizations.title: Occupancy
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT DATE(etl_data_hourly.date) AS day, HOUR(etl_data_hourly.date) AS hour, SUM(etl_data_hourly.value) AS total FROM etl_data_hourly JOIN metrics ON etl_data_hourly.metric_id = metrics.id JOIN person_types ON etl_data_hourly.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE etl_data_hourly.stream_id IN (? /* $streamIds array */) AND metrics.name = 'Occupancy' AND person_types.name != 'Staff' AND etl_data_hourly.date BETWEEN ? /* $startOfToday */ AND ? /* $endOfToday */ GROUP BY DATE(etl_data_hourly.date), HOUR(etl_data_hourly.date);

visualizations.title: Age Gender Demographics
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT genders.gender, sentiments.sentiment, age_groups.group_name, SUM(etl_data_hourly.value) AS total FROM etl_data_hourly JOIN demographics ON etl_data_hourly.demographics_id = demographics.id JOIN person_types ON etl_data_hourly.person_type_id = person_types.id JOIN age_groups ON demographics.age_group_id = age_groups.id JOIN genders ON demographics.gender_id = genders.id JOIN sentiments ON demographics.sentiment_id = sentiments.id WHERE etl_data_hourly.stream_id IN (? /* $streamIds array */) AND etl_data_hourly.date BETWEEN ? /* $startOfToday */ AND ? /* $endOfToday */ AND person_types.name != 'Staff' GROUP BY genders.gender, sentiments.sentiment, age_groups.group_name;

visualizations.title: Age Sentiment Demographics
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT genders.gender, sentiments.sentiment, age_groups.group_name, SUM(etl_data_hourly.value) AS total FROM etl_data_hourly JOIN demographics ON etl_data_hourly.demographics_id = demographics.id JOIN person_types ON etl_data_hourly.person_type_id = person_types.id JOIN age_groups ON demographics.age_group_id = age_groups.id JOIN genders ON demographics.gender_id = genders.id JOIN sentiments ON demographics.sentiment_id = sentiments.id WHERE etl_data_hourly.stream_id IN (? /* $streamIds array */) AND etl_data_hourly.date BETWEEN ? /* $startOfToday */ AND ? /* $endOfToday */ AND person_types.name != 'Staff' GROUP BY genders.gender, sentiments.sentiment, age_groups.group_name;

visualizations.title: Footfall
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT streams.name, HOUR(etl.date) AS hour, SUM(etl.value) AS total_value FROM etl_data_hourly AS etl JOIN streams ON etl.stream_id = streams.id JOIN person_types ON etl.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE etl.stream_id IN (? /* $streamIds array */) AND etl.date BETWEEN 'YYYY-MM-DD 09:00:00' AND 'YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59' AND person_types.name != 'Staff' GROUP BY streams.id, hour, streams.name ORDER BY hour;

visualizations.title: Staff Today
visualizations.sqlQuery: SELECT streams.name, HOUR(etl.date) AS hour, SUM(etl.value) AS total_value FROM etl_data_hourly AS etl JOIN streams ON etl.stream_id = streams.id JOIN person_types ON etl.person_type_id = person_types.id WHERE etl.stream_id IN (? /* $streamIds array */) AND person_types.name = 'Staff' AND etl.date BETWEEN 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00' AND 'YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59' GROUP BY streams.id, hour, streams.name ORDER BY hour;
